title: E-CSM-0047: slow-roll integration on the alpha-attractor potential V = tanh^2(phi/sqrt(6 alpha)) measures the...
purpose: Experiment E-CSM-0047 in the cosmology arena: slow-roll integration on the alpha-attractor potential V = tanh^2(phi/sqrt(6 alpha)) measures the attractor: $n_s$ is the same across alpha from 0.5 to 8 (spread under 5e-4), agrees with 1 - 2/N, and matches Planck, while r roughly doubles per doubling of alpha, so if the inflaton field-space inherits the mesh hyperbolic geometry the spectral index is a robust measured prediction and alpha (bounded near 15 by r < 0.06) is the one remaining input.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
